# StockMate (OmniStock): Autonomous Inventory & Point-of-Sale Engine

> Enterprise-grade, multi-branch POS, offline-first inventory manager, dynamic barcode scanner, and AI reorder predictor.

## Core Resources
- [App Overview](file:///C:/Users/Admin/.antigravity-ide/omnistock/README.md): Product overview, feature catalog, and architecture notes.
- [API Spec](file:///C:/Users/Admin/.antigravity-ide/omnistock/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 REST API specification.
- [C4 Diagrams](file:///C:/Users/Admin/.antigravity-ide/omnistock/docs/architecture_c4_diagrams.md): C4 architecture model diagrams.

## Key Modules
- `src/components/InventoryManager.tsx`: Real-time stock levels, low-stock triggers, batch numbers.
- `src/components/POSTerminal.tsx`: High-speed barcode scanning, receipt generation, multi-payment options.
- `src/components/AnalyticsDashboard.tsx`: Sales velocity, gross margin calculations, shrinkage audits.
- `src/components/SupplierPortal.tsx`: Purchase order dispatches and automated vendor replenishment.
